visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a still shot of a house-shaped lavender box decorated with various stickers such as stars, cassette tapes, and hearts. The text 'Laka High School' and 'Fruity Glam Tint' is prominent. (2) A sharp cut moves to a close-up of a young woman's lower face, highlighting her glossy, pink-stained lips and clear, radiant complexion under soft, even lighting. (3) The camera pulls back to a medium shot of the woman, who has long, wavy dark hair and is wearing a white t-shirt and a white lace choker. She is positioned in a neutral indoor room with blurred background elements. (4) A quick transition shows seven miniature lip tint bottles lined up diagonally on a light wood-grained floor. (5) The woman holds up bottle 124, swatches it on her hand, and then applies it to her lips, followed by a series of close-up shots of her lips from different angles. (6) She repeats this process for shades 125, 129, 126, 127, 128, and 130, consistently showing hand swatches before applying the product. (7) During the layer testing, she applies one shade over another, showing the combined color effect in extreme close-ups. (8) The woman brings two full-sized Laka boxes into frame, one yellow and one orange, and demonstrates the unboxing of a full-sized tint. (9) She applies a final combination of shades 102 and 130, smiling and gesturing towards the camera. (10) The video concludes with her holding several mini bottles near her face as she gives final remarks.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar progression layered with a steady, light pop drum beat. The atmosphere is immediately welcoming and positive. (2) A female speaker begins an enthusiastic greeting in Mandarin, speaking at a brisk pace with varied intonation. A soft 'click' is heard as she handles a plastic tube. (3) Throughout the swatching sequence, the interplay consists of the speaker's detailed descriptions, constant upbeat BGM, and occasional 'rustling' sounds of handling packaging. Her pitch rises when expressing excitement. (4) A brief 'ding' sound effect emphasizes a text overlay. (5) During the discussion of shade 127, the speaker transitions into a short, playful singing phrase, 'Hot summer, ah hot hot summer,' with high vocal arousal and clear articulation. (6) The BGM remains at a consistent volume relative to the speech, providing a cheerful foundation as the speaker compares the different textures and effects of the tints. (7) The video ends with a warm closing statement and a gradual fade of the background music.
